propositions: A committed operational script must build and execute a one-time history strip using stock Git plumbing (fast-export and fast-import) on a fresh unfiltered scratch clone before any publication, removing .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical revisions while preserving DAG topology, merge commits, and empty commits.

The dry-run harness must refuse to operate on partial (blob:none) clones with an operator-readable error message requiring a fresh unfiltered clone, and must dynamically re-add .bridge_state/ files from the old tip using git ls-tree instead of hardcoded lists to support future extensions.

The rewritten branch must preserve all commit and merge-commit counts, produce a tree identical to the old tip after re-add, and contain zero commits touching .bridge_state.bak-retarget/, while the source remote branch and protected tag remain unchanged after the dry run.
The stream filter must correctly parse commit messages by byte-length boundaries rather than line-based grep, ensuring adversarial messages beginning with M or D bytes are preserved byte-identically.

A fresh unfiltered --no-tags clone of the rewritten branch must measure no more than 150 MB pack size, the protected tag pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z must be absent from that clone, and a representative review-bot event push after rewrite must increase pack size by less than 1 MB with the old tip not an ancestor of the new tip.
